articles.title: Oasis Brothers' First Joint Interview in 25 Years Captured in New Tour Documentary
articles.summary: Liam and Noel Gallagher sat for their first joint interview in over 25 years for an upcoming Oasis documentary. The film covers their 2025 reunion tour and hits IMAX theaters on September 11 before streaming on Disney+. Director Steven Knight calls it a story of reconciliation and the power of music.

articles.title: Elizabeth Cook Fictionalizes Her Own Life in the Bold, Festival-Hit Film 'The Easy Kind'
articles.summary: Country renegade Elizabeth Cook stars as a lightly fictionalized version of herself in "The Easy Kind," a vérité-inspired film hitting theaters June 3. Directed by Katy Chevigny, it features David Letterman and explores midlife reinvention on Cook's own uncompromising terms.

articles.title: How Playing a Tree Scientist Made Tony Leung See Plants as 'Sentient Beings'
articles.summary: Tony Leung says preparing for Ildikó Enyedi's "Silent Friend" — where he plays a neuroscientist studying a ginkgo tree during lockdown — reshaped his worldview. He now regards plants as sentient, equal to humans. The film opens in select theaters.
